label: Grand Challenge
terms_note: Grand Challenge REST API (OpenAPI at https://grand-challenge.org/api/schema/; documentation page https://grand-challenge.org/documentation/grand-challenge-api/). API tokens from https://grand-challenge.org/settings/api-tokens/.

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: Personal API token from https://grand-challenge.org/settings/api-tokens/ (sent as Authorization: Bearer).

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit published. One request per second.

me.note: GET /api/v1/profiles/users/self/: user.username, institution, department, location, website.

discover.note: GET /api/v1/challenges/ (limit/offset): all public challenges, newest first by server order; no text or status filter, so `query`, `kind` and `status` are not sent. `id` is the slug; `title` can be empty (the slug is the short name). description, incentives, submission_types and publications stay in `raw`.

standings.note: GET /api/v1/evaluations/?submission__phase=<phase UUID>: pass the phase UUID (not the challenge slug) as `competition_id`. Returns the evaluations your token may see (published leaderboard entries and your own); `rank` is 0 for unranked rows. Per-metric ranks and outputs stay in `raw`.

not_offered.my_entries: The evaluations list has no creator filter (only submission__phase), so 'mine' cannot be selected; the submissions endpoints are not in the public schema.
not_offered.enter: No join endpoint in the API schema; participation requests are made on the challenge site.
not_offered.submit: Submissions are prediction files or algorithm container images uploaded on the challenge site; no submission endpoint in the API schema, and binary uploads are out of scope.

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific

HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: discover:limit, discover:offset, standings:limit, standings:offset, standings:submission__phase
live read without credentials: discover returned data that validates against the vocabulary
